mainDialogue.title: Ice Miner
mainDialogue.plainText: Hello, I've got some water to sell, freshly mined ice.

nextDialogue.title: Ice Miner
nextDialogue.plainText: Grab the full batch, and I'll lower the price.

mainDialogue.title: Foreman
mainDialogue.plainText: I'm here to pick up materials for a construction site.

nextDialogue.title: Foreman
nextDialogue.plainText: Let's see what you have, and maybe we can close a deal.

mainDialogue.title: Scavenger
mainDialogue.plainText: Got a bunch of household items I came across, interested?

nextDialogue.title: Scavenger
nextDialogue.plainText: Take all of it, and I'll lower the price for you.

nextDialogue.title: Spacer
nextDialogue.plainText: I can't spend much, but I'll take whatever I can get.

mainDialogue.title: Corporate Representative
mainDialogue.plainText: I need a bottle of water, now.

nextDialogue.title: Corporate Representative
nextDialogue.plainText: I got enough for 1 bottle at least right?

mainDialogue.title: Lower Level Citizen
mainDialogue.plainText: You got water? My mouth is so dry...

mainDialogue.title: Food Buyer
mainDialogue.plainText: Hi there, I'm looking to get some food.

nextDialogue.title: Food Buyer
nextDialogue.plainText: Let's see how much food I can get within my budget.

mainDialogue.title: Pharmacist
mainDialogue.plainText: I'm here to purchase some medical goods.

mainDialogue.title: Farmer
mainDialogue.plainText: I'll take a good amount of seeds, whatever you've got.

mainDialogue.title: Angry Citizen
mainDialogue.plainText: We're taking care of a problem today. Got anything useful?

nextDialogue.title: Angry Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: I need a weapon. I don't need something fancy.

mainDialogue.title: Lower Level Citizen
mainDialogue.plainText: Power's out all over the sector. Figured I'd check here.

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: Looking for some energy cells. Enough to get me through.

mainDialogue.title: Lower Level Citizen
mainDialogue.plainText: Hey, I forgot to stock up for this scheduled maintenance.

nextDialogue.title: Lower Level Citizen
nextDialogue.plainText: You got spare cells? Doesn't have to be full charge.

mainDialogue.title: Upper Level Resident
mainDialogue.plainText: I can't believe the power's out on the Upper Levels!

nextDialogue.title: Upper Level Resident
nextDialogue.plainText: Gimme some energy cells, I got plenty of credit.

mainDialogue.title: Panicked Shopkeeper
mainDialogue.plainText: This blackout is driving people crazy.

nextDialogue.title: Panicked Shopkeeper
nextDialogue.plainText: It's getting bad out there, real bad. I need to be ready.

nextDialogue.title: Panicked Shopkeeper
nextDialogue.plainText: Anything solid, loud, or sharp. I'll take what I can get.

mainDialogue.title: Clinic Volunteer
mainDialogue.plainText: There's a serious Oxymore Overdose problem.

nextDialogue.title: Clinic Volunteer
nextDialogue.plainText: I got some free Naloxgone to help out.

nextDialogue.title: Clinic Volunteer
nextDialogue.plainText: Can I trust you to give them to those in need?
